about: Fires spotted by NASA's VIIRS satellite cameras in the last 24 hours, merged into 0.1-degree squares: [latitude, longitude, fire radiative power in megawatts (summed), detections, newest detection in Unix seconds, steady (1 = heat on 5+ of the last 7 days: usually a factory, gas flare or volcano)]. Low-confidence detections left out. Source: NASA FIRMS (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov).
